title: Black Maternal Deaths Stayed Near 50.3
hook: The national rate fell. Black maternal deaths stayed near 50.3.
closing: Fewer moms are dying, but Black mothers still face far higher risk. That gap is the real story.
question: Were you surprised by that gap?

segments.say: Maternal deaths spiked during COVID, then fell to 18.6 in 2023, lower than before the pandemic.
For Black mothers, the rate stayed stuck near 50.3 after its spike. The national drop skipped them.
White women, the next highest group, were at 14.5. Black women died at over three times that rate.
